description: Asks what one wildcard position consumes. Surrogate pairs, lone and reversed surrogates (Pat group p10) against ?, ??, ???, a?b, a??b and *, ALIKE _ and __, with Len and AscW. Digits and marks (ASCII 5, U+0661, U+FF11, '.', U+0301, a, a+U+0301; group p13) against #, ##, [0-9], [!0-9] and ?, ALIKE _, with Len. One projection per group and mode. Fixture r-expr-1-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: SELECT Id, S, S LIKE '?' AS m0, S LIKE '??' AS m1, S LIKE '???' AS m2, S LIKE 'a?b' AS m3, S LIKE 'a??b' AS m4, S LIKE '*' AS m5, Len(S) AS len, AscW(S) AS w FROM Pat WHERE G = 'p10' ORDER BY Id
SELECT Id, S, S ALIKE '_' AS m0, S ALIKE '__' AS m1 FROM Pat WHERE G = 'p10' ORDER BY Id
SELECT Id, S, S LIKE '#' AS m0, S LIKE '##' AS m1, S LIKE '[0-9]' AS m2, S LIKE '[!0-9]' AS m3, S LIKE '?' AS m4, Len(S) AS len FROM Pat WHERE G = 'p13' ORDER BY Id
